meta.title: Casanita · Trattoria in Vilassar de Mar
meta.description: Mediterranean cooking with an Italian soul in the heart of Vilassar de Mar. Lunch, dinner, cocktails and a terrace. Book your table in a minute.

hero.subtitle: Mediterranean cooking with an Italian soul in the heart of Vilassar de Mar. Lunch, dinner and good drinks.
hero.ring: CARBONARA · BURRATA · CROQUETTES · VERMOUTH · SOBREMESA · COCKTAILS · CARBONARA · BURRATA · CROQUETTES · VERMOUTH · TERRACE · GOOD DRINKS ·

manifesto.text: At Casanita the chef comes out to your table, tells you what's off the menu today and remembers how much you liked the carbonara. There's room here for the one who wants pizza and the one who doesn't, the kids, the grandparents and the friend who's always late. And when you're done, the terrace and a cocktail remind you there's no rush at all.

historia.heading: A FAMILY COOKING FOR YOURS.
historia.text: Before Vilassar there was a whole life in hospitality: seasons in Formentera, years in Barcelona and a stretch in Brazil. In the summer of 2020 we opened Casanita on this square, facing the park, with a simple idea: that whoever walks through the door feels like one of the family. We welcome you as part of ours.
historia.photoAlt: Benja, chef and host of Casanita, preparing skewers on the street

resenas.heading: THEY SAY IT BETTER THAN WE DO.

grupos.heading: A LARGE GROUP? EVEN BETTER.
grupos.desc: Birthdays, family lunches and reunions. We put the dishes in the middle and there's something for everyone: the one who wants pizza, the one who doesn't, the kids and the grandparents. Tell us how many you are and we'll tailor it to you.

We don't have a specific kids' menu.

Of course. Book stating how many you are or call us on 605 25 12 87 and we'll sort it out together.
